This needs M-VAVE\'s official firmware to go on first, and there\'s no copy of it here.

In testing. This firmware is only listed on the FM-1 Resource Hub, not on FM-1 Firmware Hub or the editor site, so it may not have been well tested on a real FM-1. It may not install, or may not let another firmware install after it. Recovery might need a computer; check this app\'s settings for further information.

Your FM-1 is already running this, so there\'s nothing to install.
Your FM-1 already reports %1$s, the same as this. Installing it reinstalls that firmware, or updates it to this release.
Why?
Don\'t install
Going back to V15 after this kind of firmware needs a computer and Backup & rescue in the Mac app.
It\'s plugged in with a data cable
Some USB cables only charge. If your FM-1 showed up in the app, yours is fine.
I\'ll leave it plugged in until it\'s done
And keep the app open. If anything stops it, you can carry on where it left off.
I\'ve saved anything I want to keep
Changing to a different firmware can erase the FM-1\'s projects, sounds and samples.
I\'ll try it while it\'s in testing
If it goes wrong, getting back to another firmware may take a computer.
